Frequently asked questions

How far ahead should I book?

Two to four weeks for parties, two to three months for weddings in peak season.

Do you cater outside Cebu City?

Yes, anywhere on Cebu island. Transport is quoted per event.

Can you handle dietary requirements?

Vegetarian, halal and allergy-aware menus are available on request.

Our story

Mabuhay Catering started in a home kitchen in Mandaue in 2012 with one wedding and a borrowed van. Fourteen years later we serve over two hundred events a year with a team of twenty.

We still cook the way we did on day one: fresh that morning, seasoned by taste, served with pride.
